test_objective: Check that you cannot perform a partial update on an entity attribute if the entity id or attribute is not known to the system

test_cases.name: 012_03_01 Partial update when the Entity Id is not known to the system
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot perform a partial update on an entity attribute if the entity id or attribute is not known to the system
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Request Partial Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${not_found_entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: AttributeId set to 'speed' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-isparked-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
